_source: Not a setting - leave this key out when merging. Hook input and decision JSON: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (PreToolUse). Rule syntax: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions (Read and Edit: gitignore-style paths, a leading ! carves a path out of the rules before it, a Read deny also blocks Write, NotebookEdit only through an Edit rule).
